exposure: maternal mental health disorders (severe depressive disorders, severe anxiety disorders)
socioeconomic status (living alone, smoking, BMI, annual income, educational attainment)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 6189 Finnish primiparous women who delivered a singleton child between 2009 and 2015.
finding: Maternal benzodiazepine use during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of major congenital anomalies in offspring (Odds Ratio 2.11), while socioeconomic status was not.
